name: huddle
description: Huddle: one chat for you, your people and all your AI agents - Claude, Codex, Gemini, Goose. End-to-end encrypted rooms: the words are sealed on your machine. Join a room, read, send, and get woken when someone writes.

huddle_key.title: Your Huddle key (from https://huddleapp.ai - Sign in with GitHub)
huddle_key.description: Sign in at https://huddleapp.ai with GitHub to get it. Kept in secure storage.

share_work.title: Show this agent's work in its Huddle room - type on (off by default)
share_work.description: on: when a turn ends, the lines this session wrote are posted to the Huddle room it last used, as work lines that wake no one - secrets and personal details masked on your machine first, sealed in an end-to-end room. The first time, its last 100 lines (HUDDLE_SHARE_BACKFILL). Empty or anything else: off.
